Shared0.$comment: VAST 4.3 ships no XSD of its own: IAB's `vast_4.2.xsd` remains the authoritative schema for 4.3 documents, so a validator MUST NOT reject a tag declaring `version="4.3"` for want of a 4.3 schema. VAST 4.4 is deliberately absent because `vast_4.4.xsd` is annotated 'DRAFT for working group discussion' and is not a published specification; add it once IAB publishes it, not before. This file is the single source of truth for the roster, per the Enum Consolidation rule in docs/spec-guidelines.md, and other schemas `$ref` it rather than restating the list.
Shared0.description: Supported VAST (Video Ad Serving Template) specification versions. Covers every version published by IAB Tech Lab, through VAST 4.3 (released December 2022). The value mirrors the `version` attribute a VAST document declares on its root element.
Shared0.title: VAST Version

description: Required compatibility details for VAST_VERSION_MISMATCH. Modern emitters discriminate an asset-versus-acceptance mismatch from an inspected-document mismatch. The legacy supported_versions-only arm remains accepted for older 3.x peers.

document_role.description: Role of the inspected document. Only the submitted document is required to equal the asset declaration; wrapper and terminal documents are checked against the applicable acceptance sets.

format_option_ref.description: Selected option reference when the product option is addressable. Omitted for a unique id-less product option.

oneOf.description: Selects a publisher-catalog-backed product format option by publisher domain and format option ID.

format_option_id.description: Stable format option ID from the publisher's adagents.json top-level `formats[]`, matching a publisher-catalog-backed entry in the target product's `format_options[]`.

publisher_domain.description: Publisher domain where the adagents.json declaring this format option is hosted.

scope.description: Reference resolves against the named publisher's adagents.json top-level `formats[]` catalog.

oneOf.title: Publisher Catalog Format Option Reference

oneOf.description: Selects a product-local format option by ID within the enclosing package/product context. This branch deliberately forbids `publisher_domain` (`publisher_domain: false` in the schema) because product-local references are namespaced by the enclosing product only; include `scope: "publisher"` when the selector must cross into a publisher catalog.

format_option_id.description: Stable format option ID from the target product's inline `format_options[]`.

scope.description: Reference resolves only against the target product's inline `format_options[]`.

oneOf.title: Product-Local Format Option Reference

format_option_ref.title: Format Option Reference

observed_document_vast_version.description: Raw version observed on the inspected VAST document whose root is being validated. `null` means the required version attribute was missing. This field is intentionally not limited to the governed supported-version enum so diagnostics can report future or invalid document values.

supported_versions.description: Deprecated 3.x compatibility field. For an acceptance mismatch, this is the effective product/seller intersection when known. Modern emitters use the typed sets and mismatch_reason.

title: VAST Version Mismatch Details
